entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been trying to sort this out for ages. I bought this ProFit jersey and it's completely useless. I want to return it right now!
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase, sir. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
What's the issue? It's the wrong size! It's advertised as a standard fit, but this thing is so incredibly tight I can't even zip it up. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration with the fit. So just to confirm, you feel the sizing is inaccurate and you'd like to proceed with a return?

Yes! I want to exchange it for a bigger size or just get my money back. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm one click away from leaving a review that will curl your hair.
That won't be necessary, sir, I am happy to resolve this for you. I just need to pull up your account. Can I get your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the ProFit Jersey was delivered 38 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Alright, I've checked and you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that for you. Did you want a full refund, or would you prefer the exchange for a larger size?
Oh. So you can help. Fine. I guess I'll try an exchange. I need an XL.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the original jersey, apply that label, and drop it off. As soon as it's scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the new size to you.
And I don't have to pay for the shipping?
That is correct. The return shipping is covered by VeloFit. The email with the label should arrive within the next 5-10 minutes.
Okay. Well... fine. Just make sure it gets done.
I will personally ensure it's processed correctly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
